title: Count Passing Marks
description: Count marks that meet or exceed the passing threshold of 40.

boundary_comparison: There is a difference between greater than and meeting a threshold.
Read the phrase '40 or more' literally.
The threshold value itself belongs in the passing group.
Try a list containing only the exact threshold.
unhandled_short_input: A collection can contain no marks.
Counting zero items should produce a valid count.
Start with an empty count before iterating.
Check empty and one-item inputs separately.

explanations.exact_boundary: A mark exactly at 40 is passing.
explanations.normal: Only marks at or above 40 should be counted.
explanations.empty_list: There are no passing marks in an empty list.
explanations.short_input: Short inputs still need a complete count.
